years.retained_earnings_note: Retained earnings for Carillion uses total shareholders' equity as a proxy -- the actual retained-earnings sub-line wasn't separately extractable. This makes the Altman Z''-Score slightly OPTIMISTIC relative to the true figure, since total equity also includes share capital, share premium and other reserves and so typically exceeds retained earnings. Disclosed here as a limitation, not corrected silently.
